svg.title: Figure 1
svg.desc: Figure 1. When the flag's sky stood over Rio de Janeiro in 1889. For each day, the local mean time at which the sidereal time of 08:30 on 15 November (12h 09m) returned, coloured by the altitude of the Sun at that moment: dark night (Sun more than 18° below the horizon), twilight, or daylight.

rdf:Description.dc:creator: Rodrigo Jazinski
rdf:Description.dc:source: Jazinski, R. (2026). Composed, not observed: What the celestial disc of the Brazilian flag carries of the sky over Rio de Janeiro on 15 November 1889, and what its texts supply (Working paper, version 0.0.7). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24480292

svg.text: 15 Nov, 08:30: the moment the law names
Sidereal time 12h 09m, 1889, one point a day. Data: flagsky_recurrence_v0_0_7.csv; script sky_1889.py.
